s.note: the party in the Valley Cher crosses the freeway for
s.how: Mash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes, finely chopped onion, coriander and a little chilli. Dice 3 tomatoes with onion and lime juice for salsa. Serve both with a 300g bag of corn chips.
Brush 4 soft pretzels with 40g melted butter and roll in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Beat 125g cream cheese with 60g icing sugar for dipping.

m.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar and sugar. Top bowls with 400g sliced sashimi salmon, sliced avocado, cucumber, 200g edamame and pickled ginger. Dress with soy mixed with a little sesame oil.

w.note: only the cutest ones make the cut
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, blend some with mashed strawberry for pink, pipe and add sprinkles.

d.how: Blend 1 mango, 250g strawberries, 1 banana, 500ml orange juice and a cup of ice until smooth. Pour into four tall glasses with straws. As if you'd have anything else.
